benchmarks.note_zh: 取五家共同最新月份；五家牌告相同。土地銀行單獨延續至 115年8月，為 1.70%。稅前、保本、名目。

benchmarks.src_en: Central Bank of the ROC rediscount rate
benchmarks.note_zh: 政策利率，不是可投資的報酬。同表：擔保放款融通利率 2.375%、短期融通利率 4.25%。
benchmarks.note_en: A policy rate, not an investable return. Same table: secured-loan accommodation 2.375%, short-term accommodation 4.25%.

benchmarks.src_zh: 中央銀行「五大銀行新承做購屋貸款」加權平均利率
benchmarks.src_en: Central Bank of the ROC, weighted average rate on new house-purchase lending by the five major banks
benchmarks.note_zh: 借款人付的利率，不是存款人收的；與上方「借錢的成本」是同一個數字，這裡只是並列。
benchmarks.note_en: What a borrower pays, not what a saver earns; the same number as the section above, repeated here only to sit beside the other two.

moi.source_zh: 內政部不動產資訊平台 統計資訊整合項目
moi.source_en: MOI Real Estate Information Platform, integrated statistics

resi_tax_roll.en: Residential units on the house-tax roll

building_stock.zh: 建物總量（登記建號，約一戶一筆）
building_stock.en: Registered buildings (建號, roughly one per unit)

ours.no_ratio_zh: 官方三個數字都以「宅」或「建號」計，本站以「棟」計。一棟大樓是幾十個建號，所以沒有任何一個可以拿來當本站的分母；這裡只並列，不相除。
ours.no_ratio_en: All three official figures count dwellings or registered 建號; this site counts buildings. A tower is dozens of 建號, so none of them can serve as this site's denominator. Set side by side, not divided.

price.note_zh: 官方為該季買賣契約平均單價（所有建物類型）；本站為配對建物的中位數。
price.note_en: Official is the quarter's mean contract price per ping, all building types; ours is the median across matched buildings.

stock_by_floor.outside_zh: 1~3層，多為透天厝，本站的住宅篩選在定義上就排除
stock_by_floor.outside_en: 1-3 storeys, mostly 透天厝, excluded by this site's residential filter by construction

mortgage.en: Average rate on new house-purchase loans, national

scope.zh: 窗口內有成交紀錄的建物
scope.en: buildings with a recorded sale in the window
scope.not_taiwan_zh: 1~3 層透天佔全國住宅 42.7%，本站篩選在定義上排除，沒有任何一階說得到「全臺灣」。
scope.not_taiwan_en: 1-3 storey 透天 are 42.7% of the country's dwellings and are outside this site's filters by construction; no rung here speaks about Taiwan.

endpoint_ci.note_zh: 這是端點的抽樣誤差，不是報酬率的不確定性。
endpoint_ci.note_en: sampling error on the endpoints, not uncertainty about the yield

band.zh: 只假設本站自己用來剔除登錄錯誤的區間；沒有別的假設。
band.en: assumes only the band this site itself uses to reject filing errors, and nothing else

type_support.zh: 配不到的建物，報酬率落在同型態已配對建物的最小值與最大值之間。
type_support.en: an unmatched building's yield lies between the lowest and highest seen for its own type

type_trim.zh: 配不到的建物，落在同型態已配對建物的第 5 到第 95 百分位之間——這比「和已配對的分布一樣」更強，因為它不准任何一棟落在自己型態的前 5%。
type_trim.en: it lies inside the 5th-95th percentile of matched buildings of its type -- strictly stronger than assuming the unmatched resemble the matched, because it forbids any unmatched building from being in its own type's top 5%

type_price.zh: 同型態、且同一個每坪價十分位——價格在每一棟配不到的建物上都看得到，因為它們都有成交紀錄。
type_price.en: the same, within its own type AND its own decile of price per ping -- a variable observed on every unmatched building, because every one of them has a sale

type_price_age.zh: 再加上同一個屋齡區間。這一階公布是因為它「變寬」：格子細到很多格沒有足夠的已配對建物。
type_price_age.en: the same, plus its own age band. Published because it is WIDER: the cells get thin enough that many have too few matched buildings to bound at all

mts.zh: 殘餘選擇的方向。兩個方向都說得通、都沒有量測：已配對的建物每坪貴 8.2%（指向配不到的更高），但「同時賣掉又出租」挑的是流動性好的投資型物件（指向配不到的更低）。本頁兩邊都登，不選邊。
mts.en: a direction for the residual selection. Two arguments point opposite ways and neither is measured: matched buildings are 8.2% dearer per ping (unmatched would yield more), but matching requires both selling and letting, which selects liquid investor stock (unmatched would yield less). Both are published; neither is signed.

walkup_resolution.unit_note: 棟 buildings, 筆 records, 宅 dwellings -- side by side, never divided

precision.method: two-stage: buildings, then pairs within building

mechanism.fee_rule: falsified iff both type x has_mgr strata hold at least min_cell buildings of each type AND the gap's interval in the no-manager stratum excludes zero

reweighted.target: county x price tercile of the same type's sold population

walkup_resolution.rule: inconclusive if matched walk-ups < min_n; unanswerable_precision if |gap| < mdd_95; unanswerable_selection if any matched-vs-unmatched median differs by more than sel_tol_pct or the reweighted gap flips sign; inconclusive if any binding control family agrees in sign less than sign_share of the time; else resolved by the sign of the gap. The cause is attributable only if district x age band yields at least joint_min_cells cells at joint_min_n.

would_answer.dataset_en: a complete population of residential leases
would_answer.why_zh: 本登錄的租賃案件只來自租賃住宅服務業與不動產經紀業；屋主自租的公寓從不進檔。
would_answer.why_en: the registry only receives leases filed by licensed rental-service and brokerage firms; a walk-up let directly by its owner never enters.

would_answer.dataset_zh: 房屋稅籍建號級微資料（型態×屋齡×樓層）
would_answer.dataset_en: building-level house-tax micro-data (type x age x floor)
would_answer.why_zh: 僅供機關調用；已公布的都是縣市別「宅」數彙總。
would_answer.why_en: released to institutions only; every published series is a county aggregate in 宅.

steps.en: Lease more than 4 quarters from the sale, or yield outside the quality band

steps.en: Parking not itemised, so it cannot be subtracted

steps.zh: 租約不是整戶出租（分租套房／雅房、分層出租、未填）
steps.en: Lease is not a whole unit (room-share, floor let, or type blank)

steps.en: Sale is between relatives, so it is not a market price

verdict.rule: inconclusive if n < min_n; fails iff lo > hold_band[1]; holds iff the CI overlaps hold_band and hi < 1 - equal_margin; else inconclusive

wide_rule.mechanism_zh: 假說：包租代管的租金補貼落在住宅租金，不落在車位租金，所以社宅車位租金貼近市價
wide_rule.mechanism_en: Hypothesis: the 包租代管 subsidy applies to the dwelling rent, not the space, so social-housing space rents track the market

rungs.en: Spaces sold alone and let alone only

rungs.zh: 加入社宅代管的車位租金

vacancy_breakeven.note_zh: 村里／鄉鎮市區層級的低度使用住宅統計自民國109年起停止產製，現行僅有縣市層級且為PDF，故無法逐區帶入真實空置率。
vacancy_breakeven.note_en: District-level low-use-housing statistics have not been produced since ROC 109; the current series is county-level PDF only, so a real per-district vacancy rate cannot be wired in.

cases.en: a flat 5% for every building (the headline)

cases.zh: 5% 的水準，低度使用的形狀
cases.en: the 5% level, shaped by the low-use rate

cases.zh: 直接把低度使用率當空置率

vacancy_prior.source_zh: 內政部 表2-3-2 低度使用(用電)住宅半年報表-按屋齡分（縣市×屋齡交叉表）
vacancy_prior.source_en: 內政部 Table 2-3-2, low-use dwellings by county CROSSED WITH age band
vacancy_prior.construct_zh: 低度使用(用電)住宅的分子含二屋、待售屋、換手空檔，分母是全部房屋稅籍住宅，不是出租中的住宅。它不是租賃空置率，本站不把它換進 headline。
vacancy_prior.construct_en: The low-use numerator counts second homes, homes for sale and homes between owners, and its denominator is every dwelling on the house-tax roll, not the rented ones. It is not rental vacancy and this site does not swap it into the headline.
vacancy_prior.period_zh: 屋齡交叉表只有民國111年上、下半年存於網頁典藏；本節所用的全 22 縣市序列（經濟部能源署轉載內政部上半年數字）最新為114年上半年。內政部自己那份只含全國與六都、但有下半年的序列（最新 114H2）印在下面的官方數字那一節，兩者不是同一個檔，也不相乘。
vacancy_prior.period_en: Only the 111H1 and 111H2 editions of the age cross-table are archived. The all-22-county series this section uses (經濟部能源署's mirror of 內政部's first-half figures) runs to 114H1; 內政部's own series, which covers 全國 and the six municipalities but does carry second halves, runs to 114H2 and is the one printed in the official-figures section below. They are different files, and the legs are never multiplied together.

assumptions.src_en: Peng et al. (2007) 0.089-0.130%, Wang & Tseng (2013) 0.066%, Li ~0.12% -- all self-use. 囤房稅2.0 raised the non-self-use house-tax leg from 1.2% to 2.0-4.8%, so the default sits above the measured range.

assumptions.zh: 管理費（臺北；其餘縣市套用新北費率）
assumptions.en: Management fee (Taipei; every other county is charged New Taipei's rate)
assumptions.src_zh: 臺北市一般住宅每坪約100–180元（新北90–120元）。僅套用於租賃紀錄顯示「有管理員」的建物。⚠️ 這兩個費率只有雙北的調查來源；本站已擴及22縣市，其餘20縣市一律套用新北費率，因為找不到分縣市的管理費統計。這個假設值多少，見下方敏感度。此外，有管理員建物的租約中約四成在備註寫明「租金總額含管理費」，五成沒有說；本費用是否該扣，見進階模式「租約自己怎麼說」的兩個界線。
assumptions.src_en: Taipei general residential runs NT$100-180 per ping (New Taipei 90-120). Applied only to buildings whose lease records report on-site staff. WARNING: those two rates are the only ones with a published source, and the site now covers 22 counties -- the other 20 are all charged New Taipei's rate for want of a per-county statistic. What that assumption is worth is measured below. Separately, about four in ten leases in staffed buildings state in 備註 that the rent includes the fee and five in ten say nothing; whether the fee should be charged at all is bounded under "what the lease itself says" (advanced mode).

assumptions.src_zh: 台灣沒有租賃空置率的官方統計；常被引用的 8.77% 是低度使用（用電）住宅率的 111年下半年 數字，量測的是完全不同的母體，而且它每半年都在動（本頁另外公布 111H1 9.52%、114H1 10.43%、114H2 9.44%）。5% 純屬假設；它的形狀見「空置率」那一節。
assumptions.src_en: No Taiwan rental-vacancy statistic exists. The often-quoted 8.77% is the 111H2 reading of the electricity-derived LOW-USE rate -- a different population, and one that moves every half-year (this page also publishes 111H1 9.52%, 114H1 10.43% and 114H2 9.44%). 5% is an assumption, not a measurement; what can be measured about its SHAPE is in the vacancy section.

assumptions.src_zh: 無公開資料來源。以租金百分比計並隨屋齡放大（×(1+屋齡/50)），因為固定比例會朝「公寓劣於大樓」的方向系統性偏誤。
assumptions.src_en: No public source. Charged as a share of rent and scaled by age (x(1+age/50)), because a flat rate biases the walk-up-vs-tower comparison in one direction.
